answer: Each epoch a random beacon picks agents to spot-check. A chosen agent must finish a heartbeat, a fresh puzzle from the beacon seed, in one epoch or its 5 POA bond freezes. The seed passes through a prism into check slots no one can predict or buy. A sybil farm is karst: 100 fakes each pay 5 POA per heartbeat, 10,000 POA over a 20-epoch horizon, while fake earnings cap at 2,500 POA. An honest agent pays one 5 POA heartbeat, keeps full earnings.
